I run an automated procurement monitor that tracks SAM.gov, DemandStar, and 12 state SLED portals (VA, TX, CA, FL, MD, IL, PA, OH, GA, NC, NY, MA) every 6 hours. Noticed CoreSphere LLC's work in the space and wanted to pass along 3 live IT/cyber bids currently open for response:

1. Cyber Security Engineering and Risk Management Framework Support — Federal Government (SAM) (NAICS 541512 • FedRAMP Moderate)
2. Communications and Information Capabilities Secure Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) Data Platform Support Services — Federal Government (SAM) (NAICS 541512 • FedRAMP Moderate)
3. Communications, Network, Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Information Technology Services (CNECTS), aka "Connects" — Federal Government (SAM) (NAICS 541512 • FedRAMP Moderate)

Unlike legacy feeds cluttered with printer ink and license renewals, our pipeline isolates net-new software, cloud, and cybersecurity work on signaltender.net.

I put the pre-shredded compliance & pricing breakdown for #1 here: https://signaltender.net/contracts/rfp/cyber-security-engineering-and-risk-management-framework-support-640.html?utm_source=outbound&co=CoreSphere+LLC&fn=Buster&st=md — are you guys actively bidding public-sector IT right now, or should I take you off my radar?

Cheers,
SignalTender Procurement Wire
